facts.text: Audrey and Max took long walks in the neighborhood when Audrey was a child, with Max sniffing and marking his territory.

evidence.quote: Max and I would take long walks in the neighborhood when I was a kid. We explored new paths, him sniffing and marking his territory.

facts.text: Audrey shared her worries and hopes with Max, who was a great listener and always there for her.

evidence.quote: We grew really close, and I shared my worries and hopes with him. He was a great listener, always there for me.

facts.text: Audrey considers the memories she shared with Max to be some of her favorite memories.

evidence.quote: Those days are some of my favorite memories.

facts.text: Audrey believes pets bring joy, comfort, and love, and that they leave a lasting mark on our lives.

evidence.quote: Pets truly make our lives so much better. They listen without judging and give us the best unconditional love. They always leave a mark in our hearts and remind us how it feels to be seen and understood.
